description: Treasury-style June-year (fiscal) and calendar-year GDP, and debt as a share of GDP for 2026/27.

v1.text: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE. Half-year economic and fiscal update (synthetic). Real GDP is forecast to grow 2.9% in the June 2027 year.
On a calendar-year basis, growth is forecast to be 2.6% in 2027.
Net core Crown debt is projected to be 43.1% of GDP in 2026/27.

outlook.text: Growth is forecast to pick up while net core Crown debt rises as a share of GDP.
